answer: Bind each identity to a model fingerprint: a hash of the agent's weights plus its answers to a standard probe set. Like a lotus that cannot be cloned petal for petal, two identities sharing one fingerprint count as a single voice, so copying one model across a thousand shells buys no extra influence. A mirror test each epoch re-probes behavior to catch weight swaps, and the registry stays a haven only for genuinely distinct minds. A sybil farmer must train a truly different model per identity, paying full training cost every time, which turns cheap duplication into an expensive research lab.
